info.headline: Minor Flood Warning for Thomson River and Thomson River at Camoola Park
info.description:
River level rises are occurring along the upper Thomson River.
The Thomson River at Camoola Park is currently at 1.40 m and steady, below the minor flood level. The Thomson River at Camoola Park may reach around the minor flood level (2.00 m) from Thursday.
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

info.headline: Moderate Flood Warning for Barcoo River to Isisford, Barcoo River at Blackall and Barcoo River at Isisford Post Office
info.description:
Moderate flooding is estimated to be occurring along the Barcoo River at Isisford.
The Barcoo River at Isisford Post Office was at 4.87 m and rising at around 6:00 am Wednesday, with minor flooding. The river level is estimated to have exceeded the moderate flood level (5.00 m) during late Wednesday morning. The Barcoo River at Isisford Post Office is expected to remain above the moderate flood level (5.00 m) for the remainder of Wednesday and into Thursday. Further rises are possible as upstream flows arrive.

info.headline: Moderate Flood Warning for Barcoo River downstream of Isisford and Barcoo River at Retreat
info.description:
Minor flooding is occurring along the Barcoo River downstream of Isisford.
The Barcoo River at Retreat is currently at 3.20 m and steady, with minor flooding. The Barcoo River at Retreat is expected to remain above the minor flood level (2.14 m) into next week. The river level is likely to exceed the moderate flood level (4.50 m) over the weekend as flood waters continue to arrive.
